response.sql: WITH groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo) SELECT g.ReportsTo, g.employee_count, CAST(g.employee_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(g.employee_count) OVER () as share, CAST(g.employee_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(g.employee_count) OVER () - 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () as difference_from_avg FROM groups g ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
